name: A100_benchmark_compile_sdpa
description: A dataset for benchmarking compilation/performance behavior related to 'sdpa' workloads on A100 systems. It collects compile/run artifacts and measurements to evaluate compilation success, runtime, and resource usage when building or running sdpa-related code on A100 GPUs.
evaluation_method: runtime and success-rate based metrics (compile_time, execution_time, error_rate, resource utilization)
reputation: Niche dataset maintained on Hugging Face for hardware/software benchmarking; limited but useful for systems researchers and practitioners optimizing A100 builds.
